Reviewed roguelike adaptation: 1.25x incoming holy/magic damage for 3 enemy phases, 30% Silence for 3 phases, 30% Stop for one phase; refresh strongest, no multiplicative stacks. Silence affects magic actions; current enemies use physical actions. Reviewed F80 source marker is the gameplay event, not a proven native status-application frame.
